thread:
Maria (CS): Kicking off a scarcity-mitigation sync for AcmeCorp's Dedicated pool. Their forecasted ramp next Tue could exceed committed quota by ~35%. We need a short plan: autoscale policy, temporary burst slots, a 30m load test, and a rollback/runbook. Who can own each piece?

Jordan (Eng): I can own the autoscale policy + model variant fallback config. Proposal: conservative scale-up for P95 latency < 300ms, ceiling at +40% reserved burst. I'll push proto config to infra repo.

Kevin (Infra): Can provision burst slots but need approval from billing for temporary headroom. Also need the quota ID and the window we expect the ramp. Share the exact CID and timeframe.

Maria (CS): Quota ID is ACME-2026-Q3. Ramp window planned Tue 09:00-12:00 PT. Billing contact is @finance-rep (copied).

Lee (SRE): I'll draft the runbook with fast rollback steps (traffic shift back to default model, disable autoscale ramp). Quick checklist: healthchecks, throttles, circuit-breaker thresholds, whom to page. I'll add a chaos probe to validate fallback works.

Natalie (PDE): I can build the load script and run the 30m soak in staging -> shadow -> prod path. Load profile: 10k qps burst, 60% long-tail gen, 40% short inference. Using our loadgen: 
```bash
./loadgen --target https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  --concurrency 200 --rps 10000 --profile longtail.json \
  --auth "Bearer $ACME_TOKEN"
```
I'll publish results and error traces.

Jordan (Eng): Autoscale snippet I'm planning (yaml):
```yaml
autoscale:
  metric: p95_latency_ms
  scale_up_threshold: 300
  scale_down_threshold: 150
  cool_down: 120s
  max_burst_percent: 40
  fallback_model: gptx-small-quant
```
I'll open a PR to infra and tag @Kevin (Infra) and @Lee (SRE) for validation.

ops-bot: Scheduled job created -> load-test-acme-1719010200. Link: https://ci.internal/steps/lt-acme-1719010200 :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Kevin (Infra): Approved provisional burst for Tue 08:30-13:00 PT. Billing confirmed temporary charge will be flagged to account team. Kevin will provision and confirm slot IDs by EOD today.

Lee (SRE): Runbook link (draft): https://confluence.internal/acme/dedicated-scarcity-mitigation — includes pager flows and rollback script. Will add chaos probe commands.

Maria (CS): Action owners recap: Jordan -> autoscale PR + fallback policy (due EOD); Kevin -> provision burst slots + slot IDs (due EOD); Natalie -> load script + run and post artifacts (run Tue 09:30 PT); Lee -> finalize runbook and chaos probe (due Mon EOD); Maria -> coordinate customer comms, renewal note, and bill flag. If anything is delayed we push the ramp.

Jordan (Eng): Noted. I'll include metrics to watch: p95 latency, error-rate-5xx, tail-queue-length, and cost-per-token estimate.

Natalie (PDE): I'll attach the load profile json and a small sampling script to capture KV cache hit rates.

Maria (CS): Also: ask Renewals to pause auto-renew until we confirm capacity headroom. Renewal risk = medium if we can't demonstrate a stable ramp.

Kevin (Infra): Slot IDs: provisioned-ACME-burst-01 (will confirm zone mapping).

Lee (SRE): Adding quick rollback command to runbook:
```bash
# switch traffic back to default pool
redwood route update --customer acme --pool default
# disable autoscale ramp
redwood autoscale update --customer acme --enabled false
```

Maria (CS): Thanks all. Let's reconvene Mon 16:00 PT for final go/no-go. If PRs and artifacts are green I'll send the customer a confirmed ramp window and runbook excerpt. :white_check_mark:

Jordan (Eng): +1 :thumbsup:

Natalie (PDE): +1, will post artifacts to the thread after staging run.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled -> 1719010200 load-test-acme will start in 24h.

Maria (CS): Closing notes: log any anomalies in the ticket ACME-1234 and tag #incidents if anything spikes during the test.
